source_name: PrivatBank procurement portal zakupivli24.pb.ua
why_relevant: Search results indicate PrivatBank's procurement section moved to this dedicated site; it is therefore the likely current authoritative list of the bank's tenders and awards.

source_name: Ukrgasbank procurement / tender committee page
source_subtype: buyer procurement page + annual procurement plan PDFs
why_relevant: State-owned bank's own procurement disclosures, including annual procurement plans (річний план закупівель) published as PDFs — these forecast upcoming ATM/POS/card-personalisation purchases before any tender notice appears.

source_name: Prozorro buyer profile pages on uub.com.ua tender aggregator
why_relevant: Aggregator that indexes Prozorro by buyer EDRPOU, including all Oschadbank regional branches (each a separate legal buyer, e.g. 09322277 Kyiv, 09305480 Dnipropetrovsk, 09338500 Ternopil, 09328601 Odesa, 09353504 Chernihiv), PrivatBank (14360570), Ukrgasbank (23697280) and the NBU (00032106). Solves a real problem: bank procurement is fragmented across dozens of branch buyer entities that a naive search misses.

source_name: Zakupivli.Pro / Zakupki.prom.ua (Prom e-procurement marketplace)
why_relevant: One of the largest authorised Prozorro electronic marketplaces; its public pages carry readable tender/award pages with buyer, item description and value, and it indexes self-service terminal and banking-service tenders that are hard to surface on the official portal's own search.

source_name: E-Tender / gov.e-tender.ua (authorised Prozorro marketplace)
why_relevant: Another authorised broker with EDRPOU-based search and readable tender pages including software-licence procurements; a useful redundancy path when the official portal or another broker is unavailable.

source_name: Clarity Project — company and tender analytics platform
why_relevant: Joins Prozorro tender history to company registries (140+ registers claimed), so a winning supplier can be resolved to owners, related entities, financials and its full public-sector win history. Essential for turning a vendor name in an award notice into a competitor profile.

source_name: Spending.gov.ua — Unified web portal on the use of public funds
why_relevant: Treasury-level transaction and contract data for budget-funded bodies. Where a public body pays a banking-technology vendor, the payment itself appears here — revealing actual delivered value versus contracted value, and catching relationships that never went through a competitive tender.

source_name: Є-data public finance platform (edata.gov.ua)
why_relevant: Umbrella entry point of the Ministry of Finance open-finance ecosystem; points to spending.gov.ua, data.gov.ua and related datasets, useful for discovering additional contract/financial-report datasets relevant to banking-technology suppliers.

source_name: data.gov.ua — Prozorro procurement dataset (Law 922 disclosures)
why_relevant: The national open-data catalogue entry for procurement information published under the Public Procurement Law — a stable, citable dataset registration that also documents the official distribution endpoints for bulk/API access.

source_name: Antimonopoly Committee of Ukraine — Public Procurement Complaints Commission
why_relevant: The appeals body. When a losing vendor challenges an ATM/POS/software award by a state bank, the decision names both parties, quotes the disputed technical specification and explains why a competitor was disqualified. This is the highest-signal source for detecting spec-locking to a particular hardware or software brand.

source_name: State Audit Service of Ukraine (Держаудитслужба) procurement monitoring conclusions
why_relevant: Auditor of procurement legality; its monitoring conclusions (висновки) are published against individual Prozorro tenders and often expose how a specification was written around a particular vendor's product. A risk-indicator system covering ~35 indicators automatically routes suspicious tenders for audit.

source_name: Prozorro Market — electronic catalogue of standardised goods
why_relevant: Below-threshold purchases increasingly move to the e-catalogue rather than open tenders. Commodity banking peripherals, terminals and IT hardware bought by public bodies appear here with a qualified supplier list and unit prices — a distinct dataset from the tender feed and easy to miss.

source_name: Infobox Prozorro — official knowledge base
why_relevant: Operator-maintained explainer base covering how to search tenders, how monitoring works, and how the analytics modules behave. Best single source for correctly interpreting procedure types, statuses and award terminology before building a collection pipeline.

source_name: OCP Data Registry — Ukraine: Prozorro publication record
why_relevant: Independent English-language assessment of the Prozorro OCDS publication: coverage, field completeness, known quality issues and access routes. Directly informs how far one can trust award/supplier fields and whether bulk download or API is the right route (registry guidance notes the bulk dataset is hundreds of GB and favours the API).

source_name: Prozorro tender UA-2025-12-31-001925-a — Tieto Card Suite support (worked example)
why_relevant: Concrete proof that card-processing platform vendors are identifiable in Prozorro: the notice names SIA Tietoevry Banking Latvia as sole rights holder for 'Tieto Card Suite' and the sole licensor in Ukraine, under CPV 72261000-2 (software support services). This is exactly the kind of record that maps an incumbent core/card platform to a specific institution, and it establishes CPV 72261000-2 as a high-yield filter.

source_name: Opendatabot — Ukrainian registry and open-data monitoring service
why_relevant: Commercial aggregator of Ukrainian state registers with alerting; a practical way to be notified when a specific banking-technology supplier is registered, changes ownership, wins contracts or enters litigation. Complements Clarity Project as a second resolution path for supplier entities.

source_name: Work.ua — job search (banking/finance + ATM/terminal engineering vacancies)
why_relevant: Ukraine's largest general job board; bank and service-company vacancy texts name core-banking systems (АБС Б2), card systems (Is-Card), and ATM/self-service hardware brands (NCR, Diebold, Wincor, Glory) as hard requirements, dating deployments and migrations before any vendor press release. Also carries service-provider vacancies (e.g. Реноме-Смарт ATM engineer, Lviv) revealing who services which fleet.

source_name: Work.ua — employer vacancy pages for individual banks (Oschadbank, PUMB, NBU)
why_relevant: Per-employer views let hiring be tracked bank-by-bank over time; a burst of integration/АБС/card-processing roles at one bank is a leading indicator of a platform migration or new vendor contract.

source_name: Work.ua resume database (CVs of banking/ATM service engineers)
why_relevant: Candidate CVs list the exact hardware and software stacks they operated and at which employer — e.g. a service engineer citing Wincor/NCR/Diebold ATMs and Glory sorters. CVs expose incumbent fleets and outsourcing partners that no vendor publishes.

source_name: Djinni.co — Ukrainian tech job marketplace (bank & fintech vacancies)
why_relevant: Largest UA IT job marketplace (~50k developers/month). Bank and fintech postings describe integration work with core-banking and processing providers, API stacks, and team structure. Company-filtered URLs (e.g. OTP Bank UA) allow per-bank hiring tracking.

source_name: DOU jobs — company profiles for Ukrainian banks (Oschadbank, PUMB/FUIB, Raiffeisen, mono)
source_subtype: IT community job board + company profiles
why_relevant: DOU company profiles combine vacancy feeds, headcount, tech-stack self-descriptions and employee reviews. Raiffeisen's profile states an 800+ specialist product IT team; mono has its own profile. Vacancy texts and profile stack fields expose platforms in use and in-flight migrations.

source_name: DOU jobs — Ukrainian Processing Center (UPC) company page & vacancies
why_relevant: UPC is Ukraine's dominant third-party card processor (Raiffeisen Bank International group), serving banks across 16 CEE countries. Its DevOps/DBA/engineering vacancies reveal the processing, 3DS, e-commerce and database stack running behind a large share of Ukrainian card issuing/acquiring — the single richest indirect stack signal in the market.

source_name: DOU.ua editorial — annual rating of Ukrainian banks by number of IT specialists
why_relevant: Ranks banks by in-house IT headcount (PrivatBank, Raiffeisen, PUMB, Oschadbank, Sense Bank leading) and explains structural facts such as monobank sitting outside the ranking because it is built by Fintech Band with Universal Bank. Gives the prioritised actor list for all other indirect-signal collection and dates in-housing vs. vendor dependence.

source_name: DOU.ua — 'банк' tag feed and forums (engineering community discussion)
why_relevant: Community threads and interviews (e.g. PrivatBank deputy IT head on the DOU podcast) contain stack detail, migration complaints and vendor experience that marketing channels never publish. Forum threads also surface which banks developers consider legacy-bound.

source_name: PrivatBank careers portal (privatbank.ua/work)
why_relevant: Largest UA retail bank and largest in-house IT employer; its own portal carries roles invisible on aggregators, including terminal/self-service support roles that indicate POS and ATM fleet operations and in-house platform ownership.

source_name: PUMB (FUIB) careers portal career.pumb.ua
why_relevant: Top-5 private bank with a large IT organisation; own ATS lists integration, core-banking and card roles with requirement text naming platforms, giving a per-bank stack and migration timeline.

source_name: National Bank of Ukraine recruitment/vacancies page
why_relevant: NBU vacancy texts (e.g. specialist working with payment-market participants) reveal regulator-side systems and standards priorities — СЕП/ISO 20022 migration, instant payments, oversight tooling — which drive vendor demand across every bank in the market.

source_name: Robota.ua — banking vacancy search
why_relevant: Second major UA job board with partly non-overlapping employer base (mid/small banks such as Idea Bank, Bank Sich, Bank Portal). Vacancy texts explicitly require АБС Б2 administration, Is-Card card-system knowledge and СЕП/ISO 20022 familiarity — direct evidence of incumbent core and card vendors at second-tier banks.
